# Synthetic legacy Word fixtures

`legacy-customer.doc` is a binary OLE Word 97–2003 document. It was generated
with the 0BSD [JSDoc writer](https://github.com/Alpaq92/JSDoc) at
`821695a884e0c0bb8592a635d9524bb3e116cd67`, using its
`word-shaded-table.doc` model and replacing its heading and one table cell with
synthetic Chinese customer text. `empty.doc` was generated by the same writer
from an empty string. No customer file or Office automation was used.
